theme: AI-Native TechBio / AI-Designed Drug Discovery (Tier-0 MONITOR, is_theme_real=FALSE)

three_judgments.path: FAIL (automatic DROP). Bull mechanism: AI-platform 'OS' re-rates a deflated $1.9B cap as a de-facto AI-discovery platform if FAP + a string of partner dev-candidate milestones validate it. Tested vs §7 discriminators — SHOWS only 1 partially: the FAP binary signal is genuine and on-track (FDA pathway engagement 1H26→2H26), but FAP is a SMALL orphan indication (incidence ~1 in 5k-18k; realistic single-drug peak low-hundreds-of-$M, not the promotional $7.3B combined-TAM figure). ASSERTS the rest: backlog NOT converting (rev ~$6.5M Q1'26, a MISS, lumpy partnership-driven); Roche/Sanofi/Genentech are real but milestone-OPTIONALITY (~$30M chunks, 10 delivered), not a firm converting cash contract driving the cap; no margin/CF inflection (burns ~$390M/yr — not penalized as a trap, but means no inflection to anchor a re-rate). Magnitude: a credible ≥4x needs $1.9B→~$7.6B+, i.e. the market re-underwriting the very AI-OS premium it already tried and abandoned — even bulls (JPM $10 OW; consensus ~$6.6-9.1) underwrite only ~2-3x, on the optimistic validation case. So NOT a credible ≥4x → not multibagger. NOT a high-confidence/downside-protected 3-4x great trade either: the re-rate is the contested premium (not high-confidence), and catalysts are a diffuse string of early go/no-go decisions + milestone chunks, not a single defined registrational fork (not protected). A merely-possible low-confidence 2-3x → DROP per J1.
three_judgments.asymmetry: Weak/wrong-shape → DROP. Bull ~2-3x (low-prob, platform re-validation) / base ~±0% muddle-through dilution-deferred-to-2028 / bear slow grind toward cash-burn floor as platform stays unproven. Cash ≈ a third of cap (~$1.25/sh of $3.30) floors downside, but upside is CAPPED at the contested 2-3x and low-probability — the open-ended AI-platform 'tail' is exactly what the market already discounted. Rough U/D modest, not clearly dominant; no venture-tail shape this book hunts.
three_judgments.survival: SURVIVES — no ruin (the one genuine strength). Runway into early-2028 on $665.2M cash, no debt wall, no dilution death-spiral, no going-concern; pre-profit correctly not penalized. But the cushion DEFERS dilution rather than creating pipeline value — it survives long enough to need the next raise into an unproven platform. Survival is necessary, not sufficient; doesn't rescue a no-credible-path name.

strongest_bear: A $1.9B platform-STORY biotech whose defining 'AI discovers drugs faster/cheaper' premium the market already underwrote and abandoned (de-rate to ~$3.30, revenue missing at ~$6.5M). The single real clinical proof, FAP, is a small orphan that validates the narrative but not the valuation; everything bigger is early-Ph1 optionality or $30M milestone chunks. The cash cushion means it survives — but survival to 2028 just means it survives to its next raise into an unproven platform. No near-term registrational fork to re-rate it 4x, and Tier-0 already judged the theme not-real. Competent, well-capitalized, survivable — but a weak proxy for a not-yet-real theme with a contested re-rate, not a deep-dive-worthy shot.
drop_reason: no-path + weak-proxy — no credible path of EITHER kind (not a credible ≥4x: $1.9B→$7.6B+ needs re-underwriting the abandoned AI-OS premium, FAP is a small orphan, partner deals are ~$30M milestone chunks not converting backlog; not a protected high-confidence 3-4x: contested re-rate, no defined registrational fork — even bulls model only ~2-3x), compounded by weak/wrong-shape asymmetry and a Tier-0 not-real theme with weak/n-a proxy. Survival cushion (cash to early-2028) is real but doesn't earn a scarce slot. Recall kept it alive on genuine FAP de-risking; the gate declines it.
